why: Newest small Qwen line (Qwen3.8 starts at 27B). 4B is the tier mid-range phones run at 4-bit. Its hybrid Gated DeltaNet layers keep the KV cache small on device.
adapter_base_note: LoRA adapters train on this exact checkpoint and the runtime must load the same one. Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B-Base (also apache-2.0) is the alternative if training from the pretrained base.
sampling_source: Qwen3.5-4B model card, instruct (non-thinking) mode for general tasks
